items.quote: Metformin hydrochloride tablets are indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
items.note_ko: 적응증은 제2형 당뇨병의 혈당 조절로 한정되며 유방암 보조요법은 언급되지 않음.

items.quote: WARNING: LACTIC ACIDOSIS Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acidosis have resulted in death, hypothermia, hypotension, and resistant bradyarrhythmias.
items.note_ko: 박스 경고는 젖산산증 위험을 다루며 유방암 환자군에 대한 언급은 없음.

items.quote: The safety and effectiveness of metformin hydrochloride tablets for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus have been established in pediatric patients 10 to 16 years old.
items.note_ko: 소아 사용은 제2형 당뇨병에 한정되며 유방암 관련 내용은 없음.

items.quote: Controlled clinical studies of metformin hydrochloride tablets did not include sufficient numbers of elderly patients to determine whether they respond differently from younger patients.
items.note_ko: 노인 사용 시 신기능 모니터링 권고만 있으며 유방암 보조요법 관련 언급 없음.

items.quote: Lactic Acidosis: See boxed warning. (5.1) Vitamin B12 Deficiency: Metformin may lower vitamin B12 levels. (5.2) Hypoglycemia with Concomitant Use with Insulin and Insulin Secretagogues: (5.3)
items.note_ko: 경고 사항은 젖산산증, B12 결핍, 저혈당 위험으로 유방암 적응증과는 무관함.

items.quote: Adult Dosage for metformin hydrochloride tablets: Starting dose: 500 mg orally twice a day or 850 mg once a day, with meals. Increase the dose in increments of 500 mg weekly or 850 mg every 2 weeks, up to a maximum dose of 2550 mg per day.
items.note_ko: 용법·용량은 제2형 당뇨병 치료 기준으로만 제시되며 유방암 용량은 없음.

items.quote: Females and Males of Reproductive Potential: Advise premenopausal females of the potential for an unintended pregnancy. (8.3) Geriatric Use: Assess renal function more frequently. (8.5) Hepatic Impairment: Avoid use in patients with hepatic impairment. (8.7)
items.note_ko: 특정 인구군 사용 지침은 임신, 노인, 간장애에 한정되며 유방암 환자군은 별도 언급 없음.
